messages:
sam_devex: Quick async — samplekit v0.13 release window. Changelog cutoff is Tue 2026-03-19 18:00 PT. We need clear owners for: docs migration notes, SDK bumps (py/node), quickstarts/samples, and the final changelog PR. Can people claim tasks here so I can assemble the changelog draft?

olivia_pm: I'll own the changelog PR itself (will collate blurb contributions). Please drop 1-2 sentence migration notes.

tanya_docs: I can take docs migration notes and the README update. Quick question: does v0.13 change the client constructor signature?

ryan_sdk: It adds an optional `auth_header` kwarg to `Client(...)` and a small rename of `embed_model` -> `embedding_model`. PR is at https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/pull/342. SDKs need packaging bump and a tiny compatibility shim.

marco_engineering: Quickstarts affected: `python-quickstart`, `node-chat`, `rust-embed`. I'll ping owners: @ryan_sdk (python), @lina_node (node), @kevin_rust (rust). Lina/Kevin — can you confirm if your sample uses the old `embed_model` name?

ryan_sdk: Confirmed python sample uses `embed_model` right now. I can add a one-line compatibility shim in `client.py` so samples don't break during the window, but we should still update samples to the new name before cutoff.

jess_ops: I'll take rollout/canary and the smoke tests after merge. Ping me when the changelog PR is open. I can run the canary on Dedicated and Hosted. :thumbsup:

ben_infra: CI is flaky today on macOS runners; failing test is `tests/test_cache.py::test_kv_eviction`. I can re-run, but if it keeps failing we should rerun only the affected job to avoid delay.

ci-bot: CI: GitHub Actions run #58902 for branch `samplekit/v0.13` failed (macos-latest). See https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/actions/runs/58902

ryan_sdk: Logs show this error on the failing job:
```
E       AssertionError: expected 3 keys, got 2
E       assert 2 == 3
```
I'm going to open a tiny test fix PR if it repros locally.

tanya_docs: For migration notes: I'll draft two bullets: 1) `auth_header` optional param, 2) rename `embed_model` -> `embedding_model` + compatibility shim. Will post in this thread when done.

marco_engineering: Lina/node owner responded in DM — node-chat uses `embedding_model` already. Kevin/rust will update today.

olivia_pm: Suggested blurb for changelog: "samplekit v0.13: optional `auth_header` param added; `embed_model` renamed to `embedding_model` (compat shim provided). Update quickstarts by 2026-03-19 18:00 PT." Approve?

sam_devex: Approve. Action items summary:
- Docs migration notes & README: @tanya_docs (draft by EOD tomorrow)
- SDK bumps & shim: @ryan_sdk (PR #342 + shim)
- Quickstarts update: @marco_engineering to coordinate owners (python/node/rust)
- Changelog PR: @olivia_pm (collect blurbs, open PR)
- Rollout & smoke: @jess_ops (post-merge canary)
- CI flake triage: @ben_infra (re-run / hotfix tests)

sam_devex: Please drop confirmations here. I'll build the changelog draft once I see the two doc bullets and the SDK release notes. I'll poke again tomorrow 10:00 PT. Thanks all :coffee:
